data.one_liner: An audio player for Flutter with Cupertino and Material play controls.
data.what_it_does: Chewie Audio wraps the video_player plugin under the hood and provides friendly Material or Cupertino UI controls for audio playback. It supports features like subtitles, playback speed control, custom progress bars, and looping.
use_when: You need an audio player with pre-built Material and Cupertino play controls.
You want to quickly implement audio playback with subtitle support and customizable options.
avoid_when: You require a complex multi-track audio engine or advanced background audio session management without video_player dependencies.
You only need low-level audio/video playback primitives without pre-styled widgets.
strengths: Comes with ready-to-use Material and Cupertino controls.
Allows customization of playback speed and additional options.
weaknesses: Relies on video_player under the hood, making it an audio player built on video infrastructure.
Limited built-in streaming/casting features (like Chromecast) as noted in the roadmap.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding both chewie_audio and video_player as dependencies in your pubspec.yaml. iOS simulators require Flutter 1.26.0+ due to video_player constraints.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it for a feature-rich, dedicated audio player designed specifically for complex audio use cases, streaming, and playlists.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it for a simpler, dedicated multi-platform audio playback library that doesn't rely on video player underpinnings.
